entities.name: Unawanna
entities.description: Tropical volcanic island in the Sea of Serenity, south of Jamuraa on Dominaria.

entities.name: Mummuir
entities.description: Banyan on the volcano's rim, the Monarch of All Trees, whose vapor induces fatal drowsiness.

entities.name: Unawanna people
entities.description: Native people of the island, enslaved by Lucrezians then liberated.

entities.name: Lucrezians
entities.description: Invaders who used the island as a staging ground in their war against Fysmatan.

entities.name: Adira Strongheart
entities.description: Leader of the Robaran Mercenaries who liberated the Unawanna people.

entities.name: Robaran Mercenaries
entities.description: Mercenary company led by Adira Strongheart.

entities.name: Fysmatan
entities.description: Enemy of the Lucrezians in their war.

events.summary: Lucrezians enslave the Unawanna people and force them to build ships.
events.quote: the native Unawanna people were enslaved by Lucrezians

events.summary: Adira Strongheart and her Robaran Mercenaries arrive and liberate the Unawanna people.
events.quote: until Adira Strongheart and her Robaran Mercenaries arrived and liberated the Unawanna people
